user.title: Answer a Telegram bot with Assist
user.description: Messages to the bot (set up in the Telegram bot integration, with its allowed chats) are answered by an Assist assistant: text by its agent, voice messages by its speech-to-text and agent.

data_description.pipeline: Its conversation agent answers; voice messages use its speech-to-text. The preferred assistant when not set.

abort.no_bot: Set up the Telegram bot integration first (Polling works without an external address).
abort.already_configured: This bot is already answered by Assist.

menu_options.add_user: Map a Telegram user to a Home Assistant user

data.show_heard: Quote what was heard in a voice message

data_description.only_known_users: Messages of Telegram users that are not mapped to a Home Assistant user are ignored.

add_user.title: Who is who
add_user.description: Pick someone from the bot's allowed chats or type a Telegram user id (@userinfobot tells yours). Their messages are asked as this Home Assistant user, so agents (and FlowPilot) know who is asking.

error.not_a_number: A Telegram user id is a number.

abort.no_users: No Telegram users are mapped yet.
